episodes.title: Welcome to the Next Level
episodes.summary: Fifteen contestants from around the country prepare to level up their cooking skills.

episodes.title: High Steaks
episodes.summary: Teams are challenged to create the ultimate steak dinner.

episodes.title: Infinite Pastabilities
episodes.summary: The teams must prove that they can create magic in any environment.

episodes.title: Fowl Play
episodes.summary: The teams create a poultry dish; the best dish keeps one entire team safe from elimination.

episodes.title: The Next Level Burger
episodes.summary: Contestants prepare a next-level burger.

episodes.title: Drop in for Brunch
episodes.summary: Each remaining contestant creates a brunch dish that incorporates both sweet and savory elements.

episodes.title: A Seafood Tower
episodes.summary: Contestants prepare a seafood dish; two contestants are eliminated.

episodes.title: When Pigs Fly
episodes.summary: The eight remaining contestants must prepare a next-level pork dish; an elimination.

episodes.title: Fusion Confusion
episodes.summary: The seven remaining contestants prepare a next-level fusion dish.

episodes.title: Show Stopping Semi-Finals
episodes.summary: Three contestants are sent home with their dreams up in flames.

episodes.title: The Final Level
episodes.summary: The final three contestants must create dishes on all three levels in 90 minutes.

episodes.title: A Next Level Welcome
episodes.summary: Contestants begin their journey and look to make their first impressions in their respective teams.

episodes.title: Party Like a Guac Star
episodes.summary: The chefs each prepare a dish from Mexico; one contestant is eliminated.

episodes.title: No Pain, No Grain
episodes.summary: The chefs are challenged with making an upscale sandwich; one chef is eliminated.

episodes.title: Rice Guys Finish Last
episodes.summary: The chefs are challenged to make a next-level Chinese-inspired dish.

episodes.title: Game Time
episodes.summary: Game such as wild boar and elk must be cooked with care and attention.

episodes.title: Sugar and Tea and Rum
episodes.summary: Competitors use skill to cook an alcohol-based dish; one chef is eliminated.

episodes.title: Here Fishy, Fishy
episodes.summary: Chefs are alarmed when they learn the ins and outs of what it takes to make a next-level fish dish.

episodes.title: Going Global
episodes.summary: Each person grabs a box with a flag on it and is tasked to make the country's signature dish.

episodes.title: Happy Hour
episodes.summary: The chefs must create one perfect appetizer dish and pair it with a beautiful craft cocktail.

episodes.title: That's What Cheese Said
episodes.summary: Cheese, nuts and charcuterie meats prove difficult for the chefs to navigate.

episodes.title: Fry Me A River
episodes.summary: The remaining chefs must elevate their dish by frying their entree, a process that proves difficult.

episodes.title: Bake It 'til You Make It
episodes.summary: The chefs are faced with their toughest challenge yet, baking a next-level dessert.

episodes.title: Surf and Turf
episodes.summary: The chefs are asked to reimagine an old classic -- surf and turf.

episodes.title: Made In America
episodes.summary: Each chef must select two different boxes, each representing a state and its local ingredients, and then create one inventive fusion dish.

episodes.title: Next Level Finale
episodes.summary: The final three chefs must create one dish on each level in just 90 minutes; the winner is crowned.

episodes.title: Auditions - Social Media
episodes.summary: Eight social media stars battle it out on three kitchen levels for a chance at the grand prize.

episodes.title: Auditions - Home Cooks
episodes.summary: The auditions continue as the home cooks fight a spot in the mentorship team draft.

episodes.title: Auditions - Pros
episodes.summary: The auditions conclude as the professional chefs battle for one of the coveted five spots.

episodes.title: The Draft/Smash Bash
episodes.summary: The contestants must prepare an all-American smash burger that proves their cooking abilities.

episodes.title: Curry in a Hurry
episodes.summary: The 14 remaining chefs are tasked with preparing a curry dish that promises to pack a punch.

episodes.title: 80 Degrees and Palm Trees
episodes.summary: The 13 remaining chefs prepare a seafood dish inspired by tropical island cuisine.

episodes.title: On the Go
episodes.summary: The chefs are tasked with preparing a next-level international street food dish.

episodes.title: Don't Have a Cow, Man
episodes.summary: The chefs butcher and break down various cuts of beef amongst their teams to create steak dishes.

episodes.title: You Wanna Pizza Me?
episodes.summary: The contestants must elevate traditional pizza into a next-level masterpiece.

episodes.title: It's All Greek to Me
episodes.summary: The chef who prepares the best Greek entree wins immunity for their team.

episodes.title: Squad Goals
episodes.summary: The eight remaining competitors must work together in teams to create a cohesive three-course meal.

episodes.title: Bingo, Bango, Bento!
episodes.summary: The seven remaining chefs must create Japanese-inspired dishes for their bento boxes.

episodes.title: Picture Perfect
episodes.summary: The six remaining chefs are tasked with recreating a "picture perfect" dish using just a photo. However, once the platform leaves, the photo goes with it, putting the contestant's memory and cooking skills to the test.

episodes.title: Kombucha Kulture
episodes.summary: The final five chefs must create a dish that won't leave a sour taste in the judges' mouth by using kombucha, the trendy fermented drink. Then, two chefs battle for a spot in the semifinals by cooking a winning dish using a wok.

episodes.title: Taste of Success
episodes.summary: In the semi-finals, the final four chefs face a tangy twist as they're tasked with showcasing one of the classic taste elements. With limited time on the clock, every dash, pinch or sprinkle could mean the difference between securing a coveted spot in the grand finale or facing the heat in a final elimination cook-off.

episodes.title: The Final Level
episodes.summary: The competition reaches its boiling point as the final three chefs race against the clock to craft a sensational three-course meal. With $250,000 and a year-long mentorship on the line, only one chef will rise to the top and claim the title of the Next Level Chef champion.

episodes.title: Social Media Chef Auditions
episodes.summary: Eight social media chefs kick off the competition.

episodes.title: Home Chef Auditions
episodes.summary: The auditions continue with the next group to show off their culinary skills -- the home cooks.

episodes.title: Pro Chef Auditions
episodes.summary: Eight professional chefs must impress the judges in order to advance to the next stage.

episodes.title: Ciao Down
episodes.summary: The chefs who qualified for the draft are matched with their mentors and are given a team challenge.

episodes.title: Grills Gone Wild
episodes.summary: In the elimination round, two chefs go head-to-head and make an elevated dish using cauliflower.

episodes.title: Shoyu My Ramen
episodes.summary: The mentors challenge the chefs to make a ramen dish while reaching from a fast moving platform.

episodes.title: The Menu
episodes.summary: The chefs work to create a cohesive five-course meal, with the help of a few surprise sous chefs.

episodes.title: Beat the Heat
episodes.summary: The remaining chefs are tasked with oven roasting, steaming or deep frying.

episodes.title: The Thunderdome
episodes.summary: The chefs are no longer working on teams and must survive the next cooking challenge on their own.

episodes.title: A Very Special O' Cajun
episodes.summary: The chefs are tasked with cooking Cajun dishes that blend southern flare with French influence.

episodes.title: Tapas In
episodes.summary: The chefs experiment with Spanish cuisine; three chefs serve up vibrant plates of paella.

episodes.title: Bad to the Bone
episodes.summary: The six chefs must cook protein with the bone in, which is no small feat in the essence of time.

episodes.title: Always Crust Your Instincts
episodes.summary: The five remaining chefs are tasked with recreating Gordon Ramsay's beef Wellington without beef.

episodes.title: Final Level
episodes.summary: The final three chefs must create an outstanding three-course meal in just 90 minutes.

episodes.title: Auditions - Pro Chefs
episodes.summary: Twenty-four pro, social media and home chefs audition.

episodes.title: Auditions - Social Media Chefs
episodes.summary: Eight social media chefs level up corner store staples and try to cook their way to the top kitchen.

episodes.title: Auditions - Home Chefs
episodes.summary: The auditions come to a close as eight amateur home cooks prove their worth in the kitchen by transforming ordinary ingredients into standout dishes.

episodes.title: The Draft/Taco Party
episodes.summary: This week's challenge gets spicy with some tasty tacos but as the platform rises, disaster strikes for one chef who is too late to the taco party.

episodes.title: Sea Monsters
episodes.summary: Three enormous fish descend on the platform and the chefs must work together slicing and filleting their catch of the day.

episodes.title: Bowl in One
episodes.summary: The chefs are tasked with creating a show-stopping protein bowl with color, flavor and texture.

episodes.title: Service, Please!
episodes.summary: The chefs host a pop-up restaurant for hungry diners and VIPs.

episodes.title: Mini Gordon
episodes.summary: The chefs are tasked with reimagining kids' classic dishes, taking nostalgic flavors and elevating them into culinary masterpieces; one more chef is eliminated.

episodes.title: Ale's Well That Ends Well
episodes.summary: Proteins must be paired with perfectly poured beer to create delicious dishes; contestants play beer pong in order to win more ingredients.

episodes.title: Cowboy Cooking
episodes.summary: The chefs take rustic ranch cooking to the next level.

episodes.title: The In-Season Tournament
episodes.summary: The chefs are no longer competing on their teams, and it's each person for themselves as they fight for their place on the top level.

episodes.title: Use Your Noodle
episodes.summary: The seven remaining chefs must make a noodle dish that honors tradition while elevating this ingredient that is loved all over the world.

episodes.title: A Toast to America's 250th
episodes.summary: The chefs cook for a star-spangled cocktail party in celebration of America's 250th, where they craft a showstopping cocktail and appetizer.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Goal
episodes.summary: This summer, the Fifa World Cup is coming to FOX and with only five chefs left, the worlds of soccer and food are fused in a special, championship-inspired episode. USA Soccer legend Alexi Lalas makes a surprise appearance, and the chefs need to create a world-class fusion dish with ingredients tied to two different countries.

episodes.title: Building a Legacy
episodes.summary: It's the semi-finals which means four chefs are within reach of the finale! The chefs must create a signature dish that they feel defines them, but there is a hidden catch. This is the moment that could define their legacy.

episodes.title: The Final Level
episodes.summary: It's the finale and the three remaining chefs must create a dish on each level in just 90 minutes. How they divide their time is up to them.
